title: 2026 UK GHG iron and steel methodology QA controls

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes
Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 method update changes iron and steel fuel-data estimation.
A 5-year average is applied to fuel data for 2022, 2023 and 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute annual fuel data for those years.

facts.source_fact: Previously annual fuel data was used.
facts.expected_handling: Keep old and revised methods distinct.

facts.source_fact: Recent coke oven closures weakened the justification for the previous method.
The UK iron and steel industry has relied on imported coke after the closures.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer domestic coke-oven activity from steel output.

facts.source_fact: UK coke oven coke data is no longer valid as the sole tracking basis for iron and steel emissions.
Alignment with operator ETS data had deteriorated.
The revised averaging improves alignment to ETS data.
facts.expected_handling: Treat alignment as method validation, not direct measurement.

facts.source_fact: The change is exclusive to the industry sector.
The change decreases estimates for 2022 and 2023.
